methods.label: Comparing rectangle and parallelogram properties
methods.explanation: Equal opposite sides, equal opposite angles, and diagonals that bisect each other are properties of all parallelograms. Equal diagonals are a special property of rectangles.
methods.levelReason: Compares the standard Grade 8 properties of rectangles and parallelograms.
